findings.summary: NullPointerException crash on first app launch: readStringFromSharedPreferences returns null for a never-written key, then .isEmpty() is called on null
findings.failure_scenario: Fresh install: SharedPreferences has no entry for KEY_SHARED_PREFERENCES_HISTORIES. sharedPref.getString(key, null) returns null. Java expression null.isEmpty() throws NullPointerException, crashing MainActivity.onCreate() before any UI appears.

findings.summary: Existing user data loss on upgrade — old clicked-story IDs (KEY_SHARED_PREFERENCES_CLICKED_IDS) are never migrated to the new histories format
findings.failure_scenario: A user upgrades from a previous version. Their Set of previously-clicked story IDs stored under the old shared-preferences key KEY_SHARED_PREFERENCES_CLICKED_IDS is completely ignored. No migration reads that key; the new history system starts empty. All stories appear unread and the old reading history is permanently lost.

findings.summary: Clearing history in Settings only clears SharedPreferences but leaves the HistoriesUtils in-memory list untouched, so isHistoryExist() continues returning stale true values
findings.failure_scenario: User opens Settings, taps 'Clear clicked stories'. SharedPreferences is saved as empty string, snackbar reports correct old count. User returns to the story list — HistoriesUtils.histories still contains all old entries because clear() never calls HistoriesUtils.init() or clears the list. Stories remain visually marked as 'clicked', hide-clicked filter still hides them. Only an app restart fixes it.

findings.summary: HistoriesUtils.addHistory uses one System.currentTimeMillis() for the in-memory entry and UtilsKt.addHistory uses a separate call for persistence, producing divergent timestamps and an unsorted in-memory list
findings.failure_scenario: User clicks a story: HistoriesUtils.addHistory records time T1=1700000000000 in memory (appended unsorted to end of list). UtilsKt.addHistory independently calls System.currentTimeMillis() giving T2=1700000000003, then sorts the persisted list by descending time. In-memory list order diverges from persisted order. On next init(), T2 overwrites T1. Repeated across a session with many clicks, the in-memory list becomes progressively more unsorted from the persisted order.

findings.summary: Dead code — getHistorybyId() result assigned to variable h but never read, performing an unnecessary linear scan of the history list on every long-press
findings.failure_scenario: User long-presses any story: a linear O(n) scan of the in-memory HistoriesUtils.histories list runs via getHistorybyId(story.id). The result is assigned to variable h but the variable is never referenced — no logic uses it. The scan is wasted computation on every long-press, and the unused variable suggests an unfinished feature.
